finding: Agreement between independently exhaustive exact-commit enumerations is necessary but not sufficient while the workflow-run set or run statuses may still change. Promotion requires two complete snapshots for the same commit, separated by a declared quiet period, with identical normalized run records and terminal statuses.
falsification_route: Demonstrate that GitHub provides an immutable, final exact-commit workflow-run set at first exhaustive retrieval, or produce two accepted snapshots for which a later run for the same commit appears despite the declared stabilization contract.
limits: No authenticated private-repository workflow enumeration was executed in this slice.
The default 60-second quiet period is a policy parameter, not a GitHub-guaranteed finality interval.
The validator proves snapshot agreement and terminality, not deployment identity or artifact correctness.
privacy_boundary: Repository operational metadata only; no credentials, private chat, health material, contacts, or personal identifiers retained.
